design.purpose: A compact open planter for herbs or flowers on a patio, with 20 cm deep sides for soil and drainage holes in the base.

steps.c: Place board A flat for cutting
Cut front, back and both ends
Place board B flat for cutting
Cut the base from board B
Sand cut edges smooth on all parts
Drill three drainage holes through base
Place base flat on the floor
Stand front on base front edge
Stand back on base back edge
Fit left end between front and back
Fit right end between front and back
Drive 2 screws through the front into the left end
Drive 2 screws through the front into the right end
Drive 2 screws through the back into the left end
Drive 2 screws through the back into the right end
Drive 2 screws through the base into the front
Drive 2 screws through the base into the back
Drive 2 screws through the base into the left end
Drive 2 screws through the base into the right end
